name: Kernel
description: Kernel gives Claude on-demand cloud browsers for web automation and agent workflows. Launch browser sessions and drive them with mouse and keyboard actions or Playwright code in a fully sandboxed browser VM. Persist logins with profiles, route traffic through datacenter, residential, or mobile proxies, and pre-warm browser pools for fast acquisition. Deploy and invoke Kernel automation apps, manage API keys and credentials, and capture automatic video replays of every session. Each browser runs in an isolated VM with a live view.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kernel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kernel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.onkernel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kernel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kernel lists 16 MCP tools, including browser_curl, computer_action, exec_command, execute_playwright_code, manage_api_keys, manage_apps, manage_auth_connections, manage_browser_pools, manage_browsers, manage_credential_providers, manage_credentials, and manage_extensions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kernel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kernel in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Kernel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kernel is developed by Kernel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
